mapper.select: SELECT sh.homeworkid AS homeworkid, h.courseid AS courseid, c.coursename AS coursename, h.content AS homeworkcontent, sh.content AS studentcontent, sh.submittime AS submittime FROM studenthomework sh JOIN homework h ON sh.homeworkid = h.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid WHERE sh.studentid = #{studentid} AND h.type = 1 AND sh.status IN (1, 2) AND sh.content IS NOT NULL AND sh.content != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_wrong_question (studentid, courseid, sourceid, source, question_id, question_type, question_title, options_json, correct_answer, student_answer, wrong_count, mastered, last_wrong_time, create_time) VALUES (#{studentid}, #{courseid}, #{sourceid}, #{source}, #{questionId}, #{questionType}, #{questionTitle}, #{optionsJson}, #{correctAnswer}, #{studentAnswer}, #{wrongCount}, 0, #{lastWrongTime}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE courseid = VALUES(courseid), sourceid = VALUES(sourceid), question_type = VALUES(question_type), question_title = VALUES(question_title), options_json = VALUES(options_json), correct_answer = VALUES(correct_answer), student_answer = VALUES(student_answer), wrong_count = VALUES(wrong_count), last_wrong_time = VALUES(last_wrong_time)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_wrong_question WHERE studentid = #{studentid} AND mastered = 0

SELECT wq.*, c.coursename FROM student_wrong_question wq LEFT JOIN course c ON wq.courseid = c.courseid WHERE wq.id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_wrong_question WHERE id = #{id} AND studentid = #{studentid}
